Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import itertools

def line_pts(r,c,dr,dc,inp,sep,bg,Hh,Ww):
    return [(rr,cc) for rr in range(Hh) for cc in range(Ww)
            if inp[rr][cc]!=sep and inp[rr][cc]!=bg and (rr-r)*dc==(cc-c)*dr]

DIRS=[(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,-1)]

def features(rg, inp, sep, bg):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    P=rg['pos']; n=len(P)
    R=(rg['r0'],rg['r1']); C=(rg['c0'],rg['c1'])
    inreg=lambda p: R[0]<=p[0]<=R[1] and C[0]<=p[1]<=C[1]
    f={}
    f['n1']= n==1; f['n2']=n==2; f['n3']=n>=3
    # per-line analysis
    cross_all=[]; cross_any=False; lines_info=[]
    for (r,c) in P:
        anycross=False
        for dr,dc in DIRS:
            pts=[p for p in line_pts(r,c,dr,dc,inp,sep,bg,Hh,Ww)]
            outside=[p for p in pts if not inreg(p)]
            if outside:
                anycross=True
                lines_info.append(dict(dir=(dr,dc),total=len(pts),inn=len(pts)-len(outside),out=len(outside)))
        cross_all.append(anycross)
        cross_any |= anycross
    f['xall']= all(cross_all)      # every anomaly on a cross-region line
    f['xany']= cross_any
    f['x1']= n>=2 and cross_any
    f['x2']= n>=2 and all(cross_all)
    # does any cross-line extend downward/rightward beyond region
    def beyond(dr_,dc_):
        res=[]
        for (r,c) in P:
            b=False
            for dr,dc in DIRS:
                if (dr,dc)==(dr_,dc_):
                    pts=line_pts(r,c,dr,dc,inp,sep,bg,Hh,Ww)
                    if any(not inreg(p) for p in pts): b=True
            res.append(b)
        return res
    f['down']=n>=2 and all(beyond(1,0))
    f['up_all']= n>=2 and all(beyond(-1,0))
    f['down_any']= n>=2 and any(beyond(1,0))
    # adjacency of the pair
    adj8=any(0<max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1]))<=1 for a in P for b in P if a!=b) if n>=2 else False
    f['adj']=n>=2 and adj8
    f['n2adj']=n==2 and adj8
    f['n2far']=n==2 and not adj8
    # touches grid edge
    f['top']=any(p[0]==0 for p in P); f['bot']=any(p[0]==Hh-1 for p in P)
    f['left']=any(p[1]==0 for p in P); f['right']=any(p[1]==Ww-1 for p in P)
    f['edge']=any(a for a in (f['top'],f['bot'],f['left'],f['right']))
    # anomaly in first/last row/col OF region
    f['rin0']=any(p[0]==R[0] for p in P); f['rin1']=any(p[0]==R[1] for p in P)
    f['cin0']=any(p[1]==C[0] for p in P); f['cin1']=any(p[1]==C[1] for p in P)
    return f

# build tables
demo_feats=[]; truth=[]
for k,(inp,sep,bg,out) in enumerate(demos):
    regs=regions_of(inp,sep,bg)
    for rg in regs:
        demo_feats.append(features(rg,inp,sep,bg))
        truth.append(out[rg['i']][rg['j']]==1)
print(len(demo_feats), "regions,", sum(truth), "marked")

keys=list(demo_feats[0].keys())
# search conjunctions of up to 3 features that exactly fit
fits=[]
for r in range(1,4):
    for combo in itertools.combinations(keys,r):
        pred=[all(fe[k2] for k2 in combo) for fe in demo_feats]
        if pred==truth:
            fits.append(combo)
print(len(fits),"exact fits")
for c in fits[:40]: print(c)

def rich_feats(rg, inp, sep, bg):
    Hh,Ww=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    P=rg['pos']; n=len(P)
    R0,R1,C0,C1=rg['r0'],rg['r1'],rg['c0'],rg['c1']
    inreg=lambda p: R0<=p[0]<=R1 and C0<=p[1]<=C1
    f={'n':n,'n2':n==2,'n3':n>=3}
    D4={'down':(1,0),'up':(-1,0),'right':(0,1),'left':(0,-1)}
    # outside anomaly along pure directions (col/row lines)
    for dname,(dr,dc) in D4.items():
        cnts=[]
        for (r,c) in P:
            cnt=0; rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<Hh and 0<=cc<Ww:
                if inp[rr][cc]!=sep and inp[rr][cc]!=bg and not inreg((rr,cc)): cnt+=1
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            cnts.append(cnt)
        f['any_'+dname]=n>=2 and any(x>0 for x in cnts)
        f['all_have_'+dname]=n>=2 and all(x>0 for x in cnts)
        f['none_'+dname]=n>=2 and all(x==0 for x in cnts)
    # edge touching
    f['t_top']=any(p[0]==0 for p in P); f['t_bot']=any(p[0]==Hh-1 for p in P)
    f['t_left']=any(p[1]==0 for p in P); f['t_right']=any(p[1]==Ww-1 for p in P)
    f['a_top']=all(p[0]==0 for p in P); f['a_bot']=all(p[0]==Hh-1 for p in P)
    f['a_left']=all(p[1]==0 for p in P); f['a_right']=all(p[1]==Ww-1 for p in P)
    # adjacency / alignment of pair
    if n>=2:
        ds=[(max(abs(a[0]-b[0]),abs(a[1]-b[1])),abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1])) for a in P for b in P if a!=b]
        f['adj']=any(a<=1 and b==1 for a,b in ds)
        f['diag_adj']=any(a==1 and b==2 for a,b in ds)
    else:
        f['adj']=False; f['diag_adj']=False
    # block indices
    f['i']=rg['i']; f['j']=rg['j']
    f['i0']=rg['i']==0; f['j0']=rg['j']==0
    # row/col of anomalies relative
    f['rmin']=min(p[0] for p in P); f['rmax']=max(p[0] for p in P)
    f['cmin']=min(p[1] for p in P); f['cmax']=max(p[1] for p in P)
    return f

# minimal pure conjunctions: drop ones whose coverage is a subset of another with <= atoms... keep if no other pure conj covers superset
# convert to coverage masks over positives
pos_idx=[x for x,t in enumerate(T2) if t]
PM=sum(1<<x for x in pos_idx)
def covmask(c):
    v=evc(c); m=0
    for x,t in enumerate(T2):
        if v[x]: m|=1<<x
    return m
masks=[covmask(c) for c in pure]
# prune: keep c only if no other pure conj has mask that is strict superset with fewer atoms
keep=[]
import numpy as np
M=np.array(masks,dtype=np.int64); L=np.array([len(c) for c in pure])
order=np.lexsort((L,-M))  # bigger coverage first? -M desc... simpler loop
for x,c in enumerate(pure):
    m=masks[x]
    # subsumed if exists y with masks[y]&m==m and len(pure[y])<len(c) or (equal len and y<x and masks[y]==m)
    sub=False
    sel=np.where((M & m)==M)[0] if False else np.where((M & m)==m)[0]
    for y in sel:
        if y==x: continue
        if L[y]<L[x] or (L[y]==L[x] and y<x and masks[y]==m):
            sub=True; break
    if not sub: keep.append(c)
print(len(keep),"minimal pure conjunctions")
MK=np.array([covmask(c) for c in keep],dtype=np.int64)
sols=[]
for x,c in enumerate(keep):
    req=PM & ~int(MK[x])
    if req==0:
        sols.append([c]); continue
    hit=np.where((MK & req)==req)[0]
    for y in hit:
        if y>=x or (MK[y]|MK[x])!=PM: continue
        sols.append([keep[x],keep[y]])
print(len(sols),"DNF-2 exact fits")

def feats2(inp,sep,bg,out=None):
    regs=regions_of(inp,sep,bg)
    # grid-level anomaly lists
    A=[(r,c) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c] not in (bg,sep)]
    res=[]
    for rg in regs:
        i,j,r0,c0,r1,c1,pos=rg['i'],rg['j'],rg['r0'],rg['c0'],rg['r1'],rg['c1'],rg['pos']
        n=len(pos)
        R=r1-r0; C=c1-c0
        rp=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pos]
        f={}
        f['n']=n
        for nm,ps in (('rp',rp),):
            pass
        # rel flags
        for k,(a,b) in enumerate(rp):
            f['rp%d'%k]=(a,b)
        f['touch_top']=any(a==0 for a,b in rp); f['touch_bot']=any(a==R-1 for a,b in rp)
        f['touch_left']=any(b==0 for a,b in rp); f['touch_right']=any(b==C-1 for a,b in rp)
        # separator adjacency: sep rows/cols are absolute
        srows=[r for r in range(len(inp)) if all(inp[r][c]==sep for c in range(len(inp[0])))]
        scols=[c for c in range(len(inp[0])) if all(inp[r][c]==sep for r in range(len(inp)))]
        f['adj_seprow_up']=any(r-1 in srows for r,c in pos)
        f['adj_seprow_down']=any(r+1 in srows for r,c in pos)
        f['adj_sepcol_left']=any(c-1 in scols for r,c in pos)
        f['adj_sepcol_right']=any(c+1 in scols for r,c in pos)
        # adjacency among anomalies (8-conn)
        f['adj']=any((abs(a-a2)<=1 and abs(b-b2)<=1) for (a,b),(a2,b2) in itertools.combinations(pos,2)) if n>1 else False
        f['adjdiag']=any((abs(a-a2)==1 and abs(b-b2)==1) for (a,b),(a2,b2) in itertools.combinations(pos,2)) if n>1 else False
        # line membership: for each anomaly, count other grid anomalies on same row/col/diag/anti
        def linecnt(p,d):
            dr,dc=d; r,c=p; k=0
            for (r2,c2) in A:
                if (r2,c2)!=p and (dr==0 or (r2-r)%dr==0) and (dc==0 or (c2-c)%dc==0) and (dr==0 or (c2-c)*dr==(r2-r)*dc):
                    k+=1
            return k
        for nm,d in (('row',(0,1)),('col',(1,0)),('diag',(1,1)),('anti',(1,-1))):
            cnts=[linecnt(p,d) for p in pos]
            f['%smax'%nm]=max(cnts); f['%smin'%nm]=min(cnts); f['%sany'%nm]=any(c>0 for c in cnts); f['%sall'%nm]=all(c>0 for c in cnts)
        # collinearity of own anomalies
        f['collin']=all((a2-a1)*(b3-b1)==(a3-a1)*(b2-b1) for (a1,b1),(a2,b2),(a3,b3) in itertools.combinations(pos,3)) if n>2 else True
        # block stats
        i_,j_=i,j
        # row/col block totals
        rbt={}
        cbt={}
        for rg2 in regs:
            rbt[rg2['i']]=rbt.get(rg2['i'],0)+len(rg2['pos'])
            cbt[rg2['j']]=cbt.get(rg2['j'],0)+len(rg2['pos'])
        f['rowtot']=rbt[i_]; f['coltot']=cbt[j_]
        f['rowmax']=max(len(rg2['pos']) for rg2 in regs if rg2['i']==i_)
        f['colmax']=max(len(rg2['pos']) for rg2 in regs if rg2['j']==j_)
        f['i']=i_; f['j']=j_
        res.append((f,out[i_][j_]==1 if out else None,rg))
    return res
